integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained; deterministic computation is used only to replay algebraic and geometric identities, not to infer the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for nondegenerate disphenoids.

title: Sharp radius-ratio profile at fixed edge-square anisotropy for disphenoids
